name: How long does a window replacement project typically take for an older home?

mainEntity.name: How long does a window replacement project typically take for an older home?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a window replacement project depends on the number of windows, their size, and the complexity of the installation, especially in older homes which may have irregular openings or require frame adjustments. For a typical home with 10-15 windows, installation can often be completed within 1-3 days. However, custom orders for windows can add several weeks for manufacturing before installation can begin. Your contractor can provide a more precise timeline after an on-site evaluation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation for 10-15 windows typically takes 1-3 days, but custom orders add manufacturing time. Project length depends on window count and installation complexity.
